verdict.rationale: AutoGen documents autonomous multi-agent execution. Agents and teams such as RoundRobinGroupChat, SelectorGroupChat, GraphFlow and MagenticOne run a task to completion via agent.run(task=...). AutoGen Studio adds exporting teams to Python, serving them as endpoints, and running them in Docker. However, the evidence only shows one-off task runs. Nothing documents a scheduler, triggers, or a background automation service, so the 'set up automations that run in the background' part is mostly unevidenced. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring triggers, event-driven background execution, a documented always-on automation runtime, and hands-on corroboration of unattended background operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
